text:
The largest country in the world is Russia.

To understand the concept of relativity mentioned in the text, consider this analogy: Imagine time is like a rubber band. When you are standing still or moving slowly, the rubber band is at its normal length. However, if you start moving incredibly fast—close to the speed of light—the rubber band stretches. For you, inside the fast-moving train, the rubber band feels normal because you are moving with it. But to someone standing outside watching you zoom by, they see your rubber band (your time) stretched out, meaning your seconds are taking much longer to pass compared to theirs. Similarly, strong gravity, like that near a massive planet, can also stretch this "time rubber band," making time pass more slowly for someone in that strong gravitational field compared to someone in weaker gravity.
